rust_summary: reading and setting HUD visibility independently of first-person hands (`native_hud_mode`, `native_set_hud_mode`).
doc_summary: `hud_mode()` reads the effective `HudMode`; `set_hud_mode(mode)` selects `AllVisible`, `NoHud` (HUD hidden, hands allowed) or `AllHidden`. Existing `input_key` runs after vanilla F1 handling and may set the mod's own three-state mode there. F1 still toggles all visible/all hidden without a mod. Other hand gates (spectator, camera, sleeping, death) and `render_hand` cancellation remain in effect. `gui_render_post` and `client_state.gui_hidden` report the effective HUD visibility. Bundles need "hooks": @API:hud_mode@.
